transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining today's readiness huddle. As we discussed, we have one Saturday mobile vaccination clinic available this month, and it can operate at either the Eastside Community Center or the Westside Library. Before I can approve a site and sign the operational plan, I need to hear from each of you on your requirements. Let's start with public health nursing on the clinical side, then pharmacy logistics on supply, and finally community outreach on access considerations. Please go ahead and share your reports so we can make an informed decision together.

transcript.text: I need to share an important clinical requirement from my end. This morning I received the updated allocation list from the county nurse coordinator. The list records 31 children aged six months through four years in the Eastside service area. Per county policy, the Saturday session serving that group must use the pediatric mRNA formulation at Eastside Community Center. So from a clinical and policy standpoint, my requirement is that we operate at Eastside Community Center with the pediatric mRNA formulation to serve these 31 children.
